en.explanation:
Young's Modulus is defined as the ratio of tensile stress to tensile strain :

Young's Modulus is an intrinsic property of the material. It depends solely on the nature of the material and the temperature, not on the dimensions (length, area, or radius) of the specific sample.

The radius ( r ) and length ( L ) are doubled.

Doubling the radius changes the area , the area of cross-section becomes 4 times the initial and doubling the length changes the original length (L).

However, because the material remains steel, the inter-atomic forces and the elastic constant of the substance do not change.

Since Young's modulus (Y) is independent of dimensions, changing or will not affect the value of Y.

Hence, the correct option is (C).

en.content:
Consider the following statements:

A. Zeroth law of thermodynamics gives concept of temperature

B. First law of thermodynamics gives concept of internal energy

C. In isothermal expansion of ideal gas,

D. Product of intensive and extensive variables is extensive

E. The ratio of any extensive variable to mass will be an extensive variable

Choose the correct combination of statements from the options given below:

options.content: C, D and E Only
A, B and C Only
A, B and D Only
B, C and D Only

en.explanation:
The Zeroth Law states that if two systems are each in thermal equilibrium with a third system, they are in thermal equilibrium with each other, i.e., the Zeroth law gives idea about the property of temperature to be measured. Hence, statement A is true.

The First Law is the mathematical relation between heat ( ), change in internal energy ( ) and work done by the system ( )

This relation introduces internal energy ( ) as a state function which is based on energy conservation. Hence, statement B is true.

In an isothermal expansion of an ideal gas, temperature remains constant, so .

From the First Law: .

But as per statement , in isothermal process , so statement is False.

Intensive variables are the properties which do not depend on size, for example temperature and pressure.

Extensive variables are the properties depend on size, for example volume.

The product of intensive and extensive property represents work or energy, which depends with the size of the system. Therefore, the product is extensive.

When an extensive variable (like volume or heat capacity) is divided by mass, it becomes a specific quantity (like specific volume or specific heat). Specific quantities are intensive because they do not depend on the total mass of the system. Statement E says it remains extensive, so it is False.

Therefore, only A, B, and D are correct. Hence, the correct option is (C).

प्रथम नियम ऊष्मा ( ), आंतरिक ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन ( ) और निकाय द्वारा किए गए कार्य ( ) के बीच का गणितीय संबंध है।

जब किसी विस्तीर्ण चर (जैसे आयतन या ऊष्मा धारिता) को द्रव्यमान से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो यह एक विशिष्ट राशि (जैसे विशिष्ट आयतन या विशिष्ट ऊष्मा) बन जाता है। विशिष्ट राशियाँ गहन (intensive) होती हैं क्योंकि वे निकाय के कुल द्रव्यमान पर निर्भर नहीं करती हैं। कथन E कहता है कि यह विस्तीर्ण ही रहता है, इसलिए यह असत्य है।
